def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']  # number of people
    k = inputs['k']  # every k-th person is eliminated
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position (0-indexed)
    # We'll simulate the elimination process
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))  # positions 1..n
    current_idx = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Remove every k-th person
        current_idx = (current_idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current_idx)
        # Adjust index if we're at the end
        if current_idx >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_idx = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
